svg.title: Prepare and prove a recovery candidate before moving traffic
svg.desc: A suspected incident is checked against a fresh, independent customer signal and assigned to an owner. Repeatable restore steps prepare a separate recovery candidate. Business records, key access, old-writer isolation and capacity are then checked. Passing these preparation steps does not itself authorize traffic cutover; the cutover decision is a separate gate.
svg.text: Prepare a candidate. Keep traffic still.
A recovery runbook can execute steps; it cannot invent evidence.
Check a fresh, independent customer signal.
Name the affected scope and responsible owner.
Choose a recovery point and restore it.
Reconcile bookings; test keys and dependencies.
Fence the old writer; test capacity.
A completed restore job alone is not this proof.
Stop here if evidence is missing or stale.
Do not move the customer route yet.
Teaching sequence only; not an installed AWS workflow or timing guarantee.
